about_the_game:
Monterey Jack with his cursed cheese dip bring everything they touch—dolls, mannequins, even factory machines—to life in horrifying, twisted forms. Play as high school junior Gordi and enter the abandoned Monterey Jack Cheese Factory in search of your missing friend Mikey.

WILLY WONKA MEETS HELL

Drip, drop, the dairy's near—Monterey Jack is what you fear!

Monterey Jack hunts you dynamically in real time in a style similar to iconic horror pursuers like Mr. X or the Xenomorph in Alien: Isolation.

OUTRUN, OUTSMART, AND SURVIVE


Enemies have detailed hitboxes, requiring players to use their slingshot to find weak spots.

Use makeshift weapons such as slingshots, nail guns, and fire extinguishers to fight a large cast of cheese-born baddies.

EXPLORE THE MASSIVE CHEESE FACTORY

Travel the cheese river to explore the cheese factory.

Monterey Jack offers a solid 3 to 4-hour horror experience packed with terrifying encounters, intense chases, and heart-stopping jumpscares. With multiple endings, leaderboards, and even a horde mode.

content_descriptors.notes: Players will encounter grotesque cheese-themed monsters, including the terrifying Monterey Jack, who relentlessly hunts them. The game features scenes of violence, including melee and ranged combat against nightmarish creatures.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad core processor
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 or AMD RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Run, run, run as fast as you can, you can’t escape the Cheese Man! Explore a horrifying cheese factory theme park, armed with just a slingshot and your phone light, while being hunted by a towering cheese monster named Monterey Jack.
